copy_pose: Copy the current pose from the selected controls.
The pose remains available across Maya sessions.
paste_pose: Paste the saved pose onto the current selection.
paste_mirror_pose: Paste the saved pose onto matching opposite-side controls using mirror exceptions.
paste_pose_to: Choose a copied source control and paste its pose onto the selected targets.
export_pose: Export the copied pose data to a JSON file.
import_pose: Import copied pose data from a JSON file.
copy_animation: Copy animation from the selected objects or controls.
The animation remains available across Maya sessions.
paste_animation: Replace animation on the current selection with the saved animation.
paste_insert_animation: Insert the saved animation while preserving surrounding timing.
paste_opposite_animation: Paste the saved animation onto matching opposite-side controls.
paste_animation_to: Choose a copied source control and paste its animation onto selected targets.
export_animation: Export the copied animation data to a JSON file.
import_animation: Import copied animation data from a JSON file.
